mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in a month coincides with a 5-day forward S&P 500 return of +1.5% due to market anticipation of rate hikes being delayed.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3 in a given month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns after CPIAUCSL > 0.3 months do not outperform a 20-day return baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 10,000 jobs in a single month, it predicts a +3% S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer demand.
failure_condition: Across 10 such expansion months, the average 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than during contraction months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO index above 95.0 signals robust manufacturing capacity, which precedes a +2% S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as markets price in sustained supply strength.
failure_condition: In 5 consecutive months with INDPRO > 95.0, the 60-day forward returns do not exceed the 95th percentile of all 60-day returns (IC > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both HOUST (energy consumption) and RSAFS (services demand) by at least 2% each, during a recession regime, predicts a -3% S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as profit-taking and risk aversion intensify.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prev_month by >=2% AND RSAFS < prev_month by >=2% AND recession regime
failure_condition: During 10 identified recession months with this dual-demand decline, 20-day forward returns do not fall below the 10th percentile of all recession 20-day returns (IC > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.2% in a month, the S&P 500 shows a -1.5% 5-day forward return as markets anticipate tighter credit conditions and reduced investment appetite.
failure_condition: Over 8 such months, the 5-day forward returns do not exhibit a statistically significant negative excess return relative to a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 6.5% for two consecutive months predicts a -2% S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days as low-wage growth discourages consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: During 5 such cooling periods, the 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during labor expansion periods (IC > 0.12).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (GDP demand) grows by more than 4% in a quarter, the S&P 500 posts a +4% 20-day forward return as markets anticipate robust earnings and margin expansion.
failure_condition: In 8 quarters with GDPC1 > 4% growth, the 20-day forward returns do not exceed the 90th percentile of all 20-day returns (IC > 0.20).

mechanism_narrative: A coincident decline in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL by at least 0.2% and 0.3% respectively in a month triggers a -2% S&P 500 5-day forward return as markets anticipate a dual softening in policy and price pressures.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < prev_month by >=0.2% AND CPIAUCSL < prev_month by >=0.3%
failure_condition: During 6 such months, the 5-day forward returns do not fall below the 5th percentile of all 5-day returns during softening events (IC > 0.18).
